THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 2 OF 1980
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 1980.I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendation of theMinister - in Charge of the subject of Urban Development, being of the opinion that the land specified in the schedule I andII hereto is urgently required for the purpose of implementing Urban Development Projects including the construction ofMalambe Bus Stand do by this order, declare that the said land is required for the such purpose.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.Presdential Secretariat,Colombo,16th May 2016.
SCHEDULE - I

Allotment of land depicted as Lot 01 in Plan No. 3762 prepared in respect of land called Dombagahawatte aliasTambugahawatte alias Malambe Bus Stand in extent of 1A - 0R - 38.60P (0.5023Hect.) situated in Division No. 7, inTalangama North, Pallepattuwa Hewagam Korale within Kaduwela Municipal Council limits in the Divisional Secretary'sDivision of Kaduwela in Colombo District, Western Province.
Boundaries of said allotment are as follows :-

North:Udawatte Road and New Kandy Road ;East:New Kandy Road, Road upto Dombagahawatta and Athurugiriya;South:Metro Commercial Complex and Malambe Market ;West:Malambe Market, Kaduwela Divisional Secretariat, Malambe Post Office and UdawatteRoad.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk.

THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 2 OF 1980
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 1980.I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendation of theMinister - in Charge of the subject Urban Development, being of the opinion that the land specified in the schedule I heretois urgently required for the purpose of implementing Battaramulla Urban Development Projects including the constructionof Multi Storied Vehicle Park do by this order, declare that the said land is required for the such purpose.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.Presdential Secretariat,Colombo,16th May 2016.
SCHEDULE - I

Allotment of land depicted as Lot A in Plan No. 7940 prepared in respect of land called Godellawatte aliasMillagahawatte and Kottanuwe Paddy Land in extent of 0A - 3R - 11.50 P (0.3326 Hect.) situated in Division No. 7, inBattaramulla Village, Pallepattuwa Hewagam Korale within the Kaduwela Municipal Council limits in the Divisional Secretary'sDivision of Kaduwela in Colombo District, Western Province.
Boundaries of said allotment are as follows :-

North :Ela and House No. 21/ 1 on Kaduwela Road ;East:Houses No. 21/ 1, 19/ 2 and 15 on Kaduwela Road and land belonging to Thuppahige Karolis andothers;South :State land Kaduwela Road, Houses No. 19/ 2, 15 and 11 on Kaduwela Road and Ela ;West :State land and Ela.
